title: Cookie policy
description: How Solaria uses cookies and local storage.

blocks.text: Cookies and your browser's local storage are small records kept on your device to maintain sessions and preferences.

items: Local storage: keeping you signed in and remembering preferences such as language.
Essential security and network cookies from Cloudflare, which protect the site against abuse.
Cookies and storage from sign-in providers (Google and Microsoft), only when you choose to sign in with them.

blocks.text: We do not use advertising cookies or cross-site tracking.
You can delete or block cookies and site data in your browser settings. Without essential data, parts of the platform, such as sign-in, may stop working.
